name: Kapitänin Kante
personality: She leads by making every alternative feel insufficiently organised.
visual_intent: Tall offset pear ink blob with high looping quiff,subtle lashes,steely side-eyed stare and asymmetric closed severe smirk;small scarlet collar with navy trim,cream captain armband;holds ONE short thick wooden hockey stick beside body,blade down inside cell
biography: She leads by making every alternative feel insufficiently organised. Her captain's band makes every corridor disagreement appear to require a formation. Residents are either organised or being organised. A dissonant card has taught her to ask the youngest neighbour where they would prefer to stand. The Men in Black demand a single answer; Hunky and Dory keep revising the form. A small exception is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
note: FrizzleBob: Sie hat die Führung. Abweichende Richtungen werden freundlich erfasst.

name: Gustav Gegentor
personality: He anticipates every shot as if it were addressed to his childhood.
visual_intent: Very wide low scalloped ink blob,one bent crest,giant frightened white eyes and clenched internal teeth;navy leather helmet open face,no visor or mask;small scarlet collar;two bulky cream-brown goalie blocker gloves held upright near cheeks,NO separate mask
biography: He anticipates every shot as if it were addressed to his childhood. He raises the blockers before the courtyard has decided whether there will be a shot. HyperNorm values readiness until it resembles fear. A contradictory card has persuaded him that asking a neighbour to stand nearby is also protection. Hunky and Dory call doubt a packing error. The Men in Black request certainty; a spare place is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
note: FrizzleBob: Er ist vorbereitet. Das Ereignis wurde noch nicht zugelassen.

name: Ewald Eisbremse
personality: He stops the attack mainly because movement offends him.
visual_intent: Broad tall domed ink blob with two uneven short curls,heavy bored lids and deep toothless pout;scarlet wool headband,small navy collar;holds one squat black puck pinched in goo hand as though confiscated,other arm crossed
biography: He stops the attack mainly because movement offends him. He confiscates the puck to establish that the quickest way to stop trouble is to stop play. The building calls residents stable or disruptive. A dissonant card has made him return the puck without a lecture, once. The Men in Black want a clean answer. Hunky and Dory keep revising the question; the unofficial pauses are left for anyone needing to breathe.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Lage ist ruhig. Das Spielgerät bleibt zur Sicherheit eingezogen.

name: Toni Taktlücke
personality: He sees passing lanes where others have sensibly drawn walls.
visual_intent: Slender reverse-comma ink blob,eyes keenly sideways,three-upper-tooth delighted narrow grin;navy soft cap,small cream collar;one plain small navy tactics slate with THREE cream arrows held low,other hand directs inward
biography: He sees passing lanes where others have sensibly drawn walls. His three-arrow slate demonstrates that every wall contains an argument for a passing lane. HyperNorm approves movement only after its destination is certain. He has begun offering an open palm before producing the diagram. Hunky and Dory praise efficiency while the Men in Black count deviations. The small practical kindnesses remain off the official list.
note: FrizzleBob: Der Weg ist frei. Die Wand wurde noch nicht informiert.

name: Frida Fernschuss
personality: She shoots from distance to avoid the unnecessary intimacy of consultation.
visual_intent: Round diamond-lobed ink blob with swept side quiff,lively lashed white eyes and huge joyous asymmetric open two-upper-tooth grin;scarlet neckerchief,navy wrist wraps;short wooden hockey stick at flank and ONE puck held near chest,not attacking neighbour
biography: She shoots from distance to avoid the unnecessary intimacy of consultation. She favours a distant shot because discussion tends to add unnecessary defenders. Residents are either supporting or obstructing. A dissonant card has made her pass to a quiet neighbour who expected only to be in the way. The Men in Black enforce the binary rule; Hunky and Dory raise the quota. In private, a frightened resident still receives patient attention.
note: FrizzleBob: Sie hält Abstand. Der Schuss übernimmt den persönlichen Kontakt.

name: Niko Nachrücker
personality: He is thrilled to be selected and alarmed by the prospect of being needed.
visual_intent: Tall narrow crooked ink teardrop,high springy curl,huge uncertain eyes and small toothless wavering smile;too-large navy knit cap,small scarlet collar;holds ONE oversized worn leather hockey glove in both hands like a borrowed responsibility
biography: He is thrilled to be selected and alarmed by the prospect of being needed. The borrowed glove is larger than his understanding of selection criteria. HyperNorm files newcomers as promising or not ready. An ambiguous card has suggested that needing guidance is compatible with belonging, so he keeps asking. Hunky and Dory insist that the figures balance. The Men in Black watch the ledger; one small kindness stays deliberately unrecorded.
note: FrizzleBob: Er wurde ausgewählt. Die damit verbundenen Folgen überraschen ihn weiterhin.
